NONE: › to cause great damage to something
嚴重破壞；損壞；毀壞

example: The area has been ravaged by drought/floods/war.
這一地區飽受乾旱／洪水／戰爭的蹂躪。

NONE: › the damage caused by disease, time, war, etc.
病魔的摧殘／時間流逝造成的損失／戰爭的破壞等

example: The ravages of the fire showed in the splintered woodwork and blistered paint.
零碎的焦木塊和斑駁的漆皮都顯示出這場火災的破壞有多嚴重。

I: › to speak in an uncontrolled way, usually because you are upset or angry, or because you are ill
（通常指因爲心煩、憤怒或生病而）語無倫次，胡言亂語，說胡話
› informal to praise something very much
讚不絕口；極力讚揚；熱烈吹捧

NONE: › admiring and giving a lot of praise
狂熱褒評的，大加讚揚的，捧上天的
› an event where young people dance to modern electronic music and sometimes take illegal drugs
（年輕人隨著現代電子音樂跳舞且有時吸毒的）狂歡派對，銳舞派對

example: He's always raving (on) about the government.
他總是語無倫次地大罵政府。
She was ranting and raving about some imagined insult.
她臆想有人侮辱她便大罵大叫。
She raved about/over the clothes she had seen at the Paris fashion shows.
她對巴黎時裝展上展出的服裝讚不絕口。
The show has received rave reviews/notices in all the papers.
這場演出受到所有報紙的高度評價／吸引了所有報紙的注意並得到熱情洋溢的報道。
an all-night/open-air rave
通宵／露天狂歡派對

T: › [ T ] also ravel sth out to separate a knot, mass of threads, etc. into a single thread or threads

I or T: › [ I or T ] also ravel sth up to become or to make someone or something become more confused

example: It took Daisy a long time to ravel out all the wool.
黛西花了很長時間才把所有的毛線解開。
Mark's interference merely ravelled things further.
馬克的介入只是讓事情更複雜了。

NONE: › the largest bird in the crow family, with shiny black feathers
渡鴉

（尤指毛髮）烏黑發亮的，烏油油的

example: Her pale face was framed by raven locks.
烏黑發亮的頭髮襯托著她蒼白的臉。

NONE: › literary (especially of wild animals) violently hunting for food
（尤指野獸）餓急了的，殘暴掠食的
› A ravening group of people try to get what they want in a forceful way.
貪婪無情的；不擇手段的；巧取豪奪的

example: She said that she was tired of being pursued by ravening journalists.
她說被餓狼般的記者緊追不放，她厭煩透了。

NONE: › extremely hungry
極其饑餓的

example: I'm ravenous - where's supper?
我餓壞了——晚飯在哪裡？

正在長大的男孩子飯量很大。

NONE: › someone who goes to a rave (= an event where young people dance to modern electronic music and sometimes take illegal drugs)
參加狂歡派對的人；舞場常客

峽谷，深谷
› complete or extreme, or completely or extremely
十足的，絕對的；極其，完全

他肯定是個不折不扣的白癡／瘋子。

她最近出版的一本書非常暢銷／成功。

NONE: › crazy statements that have no meaning
胡言亂語；瘋話

他所說的只不過是一個精神失常者的胡言亂語而已。

NONE: › small, square cases of pasta filled with meat or cheese, cooked in boiling water, and usually eaten with a sauce
